# Who is involved

**Active cast.** Already committed and acting: Max, whose Oasis-based "cursor clone" "ide for oasis" built "on top of oasis" with vibe-coding "using holons" is the integral back end ("it's the same thing... anyone can vibe code it"); the narrator, who "registered the domain" and framed "the interface to earth... the ide to the earth operating system"; Robbie, cited for the "convening power of hitchhikers." The working cohort is "artists," "interface designers," and "people generally who like to vibe code and express themselves."

**Being invited or network activated.** Aspirational/unfilled, preserved exactly: "some some like really good like ux designs" and "as technica kind of people"; "another archivist of the whole earth catalog"; "that burning man adjacent community" of "hippies that live just outside of la" ("definitely possible to engage that community"); and anyone "in that design storytelling print design uh interface uh visual data representation space." The plan: "we should obviously go to them early" and "give them a showcase." Tom from Myspace is named as a sought endorsement.
